verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an API platform like Stripe, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows agent-scoped virtual payment cards with spending controls, plus an MCP server. Neither documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys for an agent: the cards are payment instruments, an adjacent capability, not API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
